description: Oswal Pumps Limited manufactures and sells solar pumps in India. The company offers solar-powered and grid-connected submersible and monoblock pumps, electric motors, and solar modules under the Oswal brand. It serves agricultural, residential, commercial, and industrial sectors. It also exports its products to Australia, Egypt, Iraq, Italy, Lebanon, Libya, Nepal, Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, and Yemen. The company was incorporated in 2003 and is headquartered in Karnal, India.
